text: This report recommends that the name "Jose F. Porto Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located north of Dundas Street West, extending between Dovercourt Road and Coolmine Road. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Jose F. Porto Lane" for an existing public lane located north of Dundas Street West, extending between Dovercourt Road and Coolmine Road.
